qr-contact: Create a free vCard contact QR code with your name, phone, email, and logo. Download PNG or SVG. Review static-code limits and scanning checks.
qr-wifi: Create a Wi-Fi QR code with your network name, password, and optional logo. Download PNG or SVG. Learn which settings to choose and how to share it safely.
audio-convert: Convert browser-supported audio to 16-bit PCM WAV or supported compressed output. No file upload. Compare formats, size, mono mixing, and browser limits.
css-gradients: Generate linear, radial, and conic CSS gradients with up to eight color stops. Adjust opacity, preview the background, and copy CSS with practical examples.
